bisakah kamu melanjutkan pekerjaan ini, tapi pahami dulu Embedded resource (file:///home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/toggle_renaissance.sh):
#!/usr/bin/env bash

# ==============================================================================
# RENAISSANCE OS : THEME & KEYBIND TOGGLER
# Mengalihkan desktop host antara mode normal dan Renaissance OS (Waybar Masterpiece)
# Tanpa merusak file konfigurasi asli apapun!
# ==============================================================================

STATE_FILE="/tmp/renaissance_mode_active"
ASSETS_DIR="/home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets"
WAYBAR_CONF="$ASSETS_DIR/dotfiles/waybar/config.jsonc"
WAYBAR_STYLE="$ASSETS_DIR/dotfiles/waybar/style.css"
WALLPAPER="$ASSETS_DIR/wallpapers/school_of_athens.jpg"

enable_renaissance() {
    echo "🏛 Mengaktifkan Mode Renaissance OS..."

    # 1. Pasang Flag State Aktif
    touch "$STATE_FILE"

    # 2. Matikan instance Quickshell & Waybar lama
    killall -9 qs quickshell 2>/dev/null
    pkill -x waybar 2>/dev/null

    # 3. Pasang Wallpaper Klasik School of Athens via swaybg
    pkill -x swaybg 2>/dev/null
    swaybg -i "$WALLPAPER" -m fill &

    # 4. Terapkan dekorasi Hyprland live & blur pada Waybar
    hyprctl eval "hl.layer_rule({ match = { namespace = 'waybar' }, blur = true, ignore_alpha = 0.2 })" 2>/dev/null
    hyprctl keyword general:gaps_in 8
    hyprctl keyword general:gaps_out 10
    hyprctl keyword general:border_size 2
    hyprctl keyword general:col.active_border "rgb(db9c5e) rgb(e5c07b) 45deg"
    hyprctl keyword decoration:rounding 12
    hyprctl keyword decoration:blur:enabled true
    hyprctl keyword decoration:blur:size 8
    hyprctl keyword decoration:blur:passes 3

    # 5. Nyalakan Waybar Renaissance Masterpiece
    waybar -c "$WAYBAR_CONF" -s "$WAYBAR_STYLE" &

    notify-send "🏛 Renaissance OS" "Mode Digital Humanism Aktif!\n• Super+Space / Super+D : Rofi Launcher\n• Super+K / Ctrl+Super+T : Wallpaper Selector\n• Super+A : Control Center\nJalankan script lagi untuk kembali." -i "$WALLPAPER"
    echo "Mode Renaissance OS Aktif!"
}

disable_renaissance() {
    echo "🔄 Mengembalikan desktop ke profil semula..."

    # 1. Hapus Flag State
    rm -f "$STATE_FILE"

    # 2. Matikan Waybar dan swaybg
    pkill -x waybar 2>/dev/null
    pkill -x swaybg 2>/dev/null

    # 3. Hidupkan kembali Quickshell bawaan host
    qs -c ii -d &

    # 4. Reload config Hyprland asli
    hyprctl reload

    notify-send "Desktop Normal" "Desktop & keybinds telah dikembalikan ke konfigurasi asli."
    echo "Desktop telah dikembalikan!"
}

# Toggle Logic
if [ -f "$STATE_FILE" ]; then
    disable_renaissance
else
    enable_renaissance
fi
  . Ketika aku masuk ke mode renaissance, rofi tidak muncul walau sudah kutekan super + space Anda dapat mencobanya secara interaktif kapan saja dengan menekan shortcut keyboard:
Super + Space atau Super + D. Gabisa, sudah kutekan gamuncul

# ==============================================================================
# RENAISSANCE OS : HYPRLAND CONFIGURATION
# Tema: Digital Humanism & The Renaissance of Open Source
# Sesuai Mockup: Rounded Corners 12px, Kawase Blur, Border Emas #db9c5e
# ==============================================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. MONITOR & ENVIRONMENT (AMAN UNTUK HOST MAUPUN VIRTUALBOX)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
monitor=,preferred,auto,1

# Safe rendering flags (Wajib agar tidak crash/black screen di VirtualBox/VM)
cursor {
    no_hardware_cursors = true
}
env = WLR_NO_HARDWARE_CURSORS,1
env = WLR_RENDERER_ALLOW_SOFTWARE,1
env = XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP,Hyprland
env = XDG_SESSION_TYPE,wayland
env = XDG_SESSION_DESKTOP,Hyprland

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. EKSEKUSI OTOMATIS (AUTOSTART)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
exec-once = waybar -c /home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/dotfiles/waybar/config.jsonc -s /home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/dotfiles/waybar/style.css
exec-once = swaybg -i /home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/wallpapers/school_of_athens.jpg -m fill
exec-once = wl-paste --watch cliphist store
exec-once = swaync

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. TAMPILAN, SUDUT MEMBULAT, & BLUR (PERSIS MOCKUP)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
general {
    gaps_in = 8
    gaps_out = 10
    border_size = 2
    col.active_border = rgb(db9c5e) rgb(e5c07b) 45deg
    col.inactive_border = rgba(45535bcc)

    layout = dwindle
    resize_on_border = true
}

decoration {
    rounding = 12

    active_opacity = 0.92
    inactive_opacity = 0.82
    fullscreen_opacity = 1.0

    shadow {
        enabled = true
        range = 20
        render_power = 3
        color = rgba(1a1e2188)
        color_inactive = rgba(10141666)
    }

    blur {
        enabled = true
        size = 8
        passes = 3
        new_optimizations = true
        xray = false
        noise = 0.02
        contrast = 0.95
        brightness = 0.90
        vibrancy = 0.25
    }
}

animations {
    enabled = true
    bezier = renaissance, 0.16, 1, 0.3, 1
    animation = windows, 1, 4, renaissance, slide
    animation = windowsOut, 1, 4, renaissance, slide
    animation = border, 1, 6, default
    animation = fade, 1, 3, default
    animation = workspaces, 1, 4, renaissance, slide
}

dwindle {
    pseudotile = true
    preserve_split = true
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. KEYBINDS (100% PERSIS KEBIASAAN JARIMU)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
$mainMod = SUPER

# Aplikasi Inti
bind = $mainMod, T, exec, kitty --config /home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/dotfiles/kitty/kitty.conf -1
bind = CTRL ALT, T, exec, kitty --config /home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/dotfiles/kitty/kitty.conf -1
bind = $mainMod, Q, killactive
bind = $mainMod, E, exec, nautilus
bind = $mainMod, B, exec, brave
bind = $mainMod, C, exec, zeditor

# Launcher & Shell
bind = $mainMod, SPACE, exec, rofi -show drun -theme /home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/dotfiles/rofi/renaissance_launcher.rasi
bind = $mainMod, D, exec, rofi -show drun -theme /home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/dotfiles/rofi/renaissance_launcher.rasi
bind = $mainMod ALT, W, exec, /home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/dotfiles/rofi/wp_selector.sh
bind = $mainMod, A, exec, swaync-client -t -sw
bind = $mainMod, V, exec, cliphist list | rofi -dmenu -theme /home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/dotfiles/rofi/renaissance_launcher.rasi -p "📋 Clipboard" | cliphist decode | wl-copy

# Manajemen Jendela
bind = $mainMod, F, togglefloating
bind = $mainMod SHIFT, F, fullscreen, 0
bind = $mainMod, P, pseudo
bind = $mainMod, J, togglesplit

# Navigasi Fokus Vim Style (H, J, K, L)
bind = $mainMod, H, movefocus, l
bind = $mainMod, L, movefocus, r
bind = $mainMod, K, movefocus, u
bind = $mainMod, J, movefocus, d

# Navigasi Fokus Panah
bind = $mainMod, left, movefocus, l
bind = $mainMod, right, movefocus, r
bind = $mainMod, up, movefocus, u
bind = $mainMod, down, movefocus, d

# Pindah Jendela
bind = $mainMod SHIFT, H, movewindow, l
bind = $mainMod SHIFT, L, movewindow, r
bind = $mainMod SHIFT, K, movewindow, u
bind = $mainMod SHIFT, J, movewindow, d

# Workspaces Romawi (1 - 10)
bind = $mainMod, 1, workspace, 1
bind = $mainMod, 2, workspace, 2
bind = $mainMod, 3, workspace, 3
bind = $mainMod, 4, workspace, 4
bind = $mainMod, 5, workspace, 5
bind = $mainMod, 6, workspace, 6
bind = $mainMod, 7, workspace, 7
bind = $mainMod, 8, workspace, 8
bind = $mainMod, 9, workspace, 9
bind = $mainMod, 0, workspace, 10

# Pindah ke Workspace
bind = $mainMod SHIFT, 1, movetoworkspace, 1
bind = $mainMod SHIFT, 2, movetoworkspace, 2
bind = $mainMod SHIFT, 3, movetoworkspace, 3
bind = $mainMod SHIFT, 4, movetoworkspace, 4
bind = $mainMod SHIFT, 5, movetoworkspace, 5
bind = $mainMod SHIFT, 6, movetoworkspace, 6
bind = $mainMod SHIFT, 7, movetoworkspace, 7

#!/usr/bin/env bash

# ==============================================================================
# RENAISSANCE OS : THEME & KEYBIND TOGGLER
# Mengalihkan desktop host antara mode normal dan Renaissance OS (Waybar Masterpiece)
# Tanpa merusak file konfigurasi asli apapun!
# ==============================================================================

STATE_FILE="/tmp/renaissance_mode_active"
ASSETS_DIR="/home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets"
WAYBAR_CONF="$ASSETS_DIR/dotfiles/waybar/config.jsonc"
WAYBAR_STYLE="$ASSETS_DIR/dotfiles/waybar/style.css"
WALLPAPER="$ASSETS_DIR/wallpapers/school_of_athens.jpg"

enable_renaissance() {
    echo "🏛 Mengaktifkan Mode Renaissance OS..."

    # 1. Pasang Flag State Aktif
    touch "$STATE_FILE"

    # 2. Matikan instance Quickshell & Waybar lama
    killall -9 qs quickshell 2>/dev/null
    pkill -x waybar 2>/dev/null

    # 3. Pasang Wallpaper Klasik School of Athens via swaybg
    pkill -x swaybg 2>/dev/null
    swaybg -i "$WALLPAPER" -m fill &

    # 4. Terapkan dekorasi Hyprland live & blur pada Waybar
    hyprctl eval "hl.layer_rule({ match = { namespace = 'waybar' }, blur = true, ignore_alpha = 0.2 })" 2>/dev/null
    hyprctl keyword general:gaps_in 8
    hyprctl keyword general:gaps_out 10
    hyprctl keyword general:border_size 2
    hyprctl keyword general:col.active_border "rgb(db9c5e) rgb(e5c07b) 45deg"
    hyprctl keyword decoration:rounding 12
    hyprctl keyword decoration:blur:enabled true
    hyprctl keyword decoration:blur:size 8
    hyprctl keyword decoration:blur:passes 3

    # 5. Nyalakan Waybar Renaissance Masterpiece
    waybar -c "$WAYBAR_CONF" -s "$WAYBAR_STYLE" &

    notify-send "🏛 Renaissance OS" "Mode Digital Humanism Aktif!\n• Super+Space / Super+D : Rofi Launcher\n• Super+K / Ctrl+Super+T : Wallpaper Selector\n• Super+A : Control Center\nJalankan script lagi untuk kembali." -i "$WALLPAPER"
    echo "Mode Renaissance OS Aktif!"
}

disable_renaissance() {
    echo "🔄 Mengembalikan desktop ke profil semula..."

    # 1. Hapus Flag State
    rm -f "$STATE_FILE"

    # 2. Matikan Waybar dan swaybg
    pkill -x waybar 2>/dev/null
    pkill -x swaybg 2>/dev/null

    # 3. Hidupkan kembali Quickshell bawaan host
    qs -c ii -d &

    # 4. Reload config Hyprland asli
    hyprctl reload

    notify-send "Desktop Normal" "Desktop & keybinds telah dikembalikan ke konfigurasi asli."
    echo "Desktop telah dikembalikan!"
}

# Toggle Logic
if [ -f "$STATE_FILE" ]; then
    disable_renaissance
else
    enable_renaissance
fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash

# ==============================================================================
# RENAISSANCE OS : ROFI WALLPAPER SELECTOR
# ==============================================================================

WALL_DIR="/home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/wallpapers"
THEME_RASI="/home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/dotfiles/rofi/wallpaper_grid.rasi"

if [ ! -d "$WALL_DIR" ]; then
    notify-send "Wallpaper Error" "Direktori wallpaper tidak ditemukan"
    exit 1
fi

# Buat format input untuk rofi dmenu dengan thumbnail icon
ENTRY_LIST=""
for img in "$WALL_DIR"/*.{jpg,jpeg,png}; do
    [ -e "$img" ] || continue
    filename=$(basename "$img")
    title="${filename%.*}"
    # Format: Nama Tampilan\0icon\x1f/path/to/image
    ENTRY_LIST+="$title\0icon\x1f$img\n"
done

CHOSEN=$(echo -en "$ENTRY_LIST" | rofi -dmenu -theme "$THEME_RASI" -p "🏛 Lukisan Klasik")

if [ -n "$CHOSEN" ]; then
    SELECTED_PATH=$(find "$WALL_DIR" -type f -name "${CHOSEN}.*" | head -n 1)
    if [ -f "$SELECTED_PATH" ]; then
        # Terapkan ke Hyprland via hyprctl hyprpaper atau swww / swaybg
        if command -v swww &>/dev/null; then
            swww img "$SELECTED_PATH" --transition-type wipe --transition-duration 1.5
        elif command -v hyprctl &>/dev/null && pgrep -x hyprpaper >/dev/null; then
            hyprctl hyprpaper preload "$SELECTED_PATH"
            hyprctl hyprpaper wallpaper ",$SELECTED_PATH"
            hyprctl hyprpaper unload all >/dev/null 2>&1
        elif command -v swaybg &>/dev/null; then
            pkill -x swaybg 2>/dev/null
            swaybg -i "$SELECTED_PATH" -m fill &
        fi
        notify-send "Renaissance OS" "Wallpaper diterapkan: $CHOSEN" -i "$SELECTED_PATH"
    fi
fi

    local r_wp = r_dir .. "/dotfiles/rofi/wp_selector.sh"

    -- 1. Unbind shortcut lama yang berkonflik dengan Quickshell / Window rules bawaan
    hl.unbind("SUPER + Space")
    hl.unbind("SUPER + D")
    hl.unbind("SUPER + A")
    hl.unbind("SUPER + V")
    hl.unbind("SUPER + K")
    hl.unbind("CTRL + SUPER + T")

    -- 2. Terapkan shortcut interaktif Renaissance OS
    hl.bind("SUPER + Space", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("rofi -show drun -theme " .. r_launcher), { description = "Renaissance: Rofi Launcher (Space)" })
    hl.bind("SUPER + D", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("rofi -show drun -theme " .. r_launcher), { description = "Renaissance: Rofi Launcher (D)" })
    hl.bind("SUPER + ALT + W", hl.dsp.exec_cmd(r_wp), { description = "Renaissance: Wallpaper Selector (Alt)" })
    hl.bind("SUPER + K", hl.dsp.exec_cmd(r_wp), { description = "Renaissance: Wallpaper Selector (Super+K)" })
    hl.bind("CTRL + SUPER + T", hl.dsp.exec_cmd(r_wp), { description = "Renaissance: Wallpaper Selector (Ctrl+Super+T)" })
    hl.bind("SUPER + A", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("swaync-client -t -sw"), { description = "Renaissance: Control Center" })
    hl.bind("SUPER + V", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("cliphist list | rofi -dmenu -theme " .. r_launcher .. " -p 'Clipboard' | cliphist decode | wl-copy"), { description = "Renaissance: Clipboard" })

    -- 3. Terapkan estetika tema Renaissance (Emas #db9c5e, Rounded 12px, Kawase Blur)
    hl.config({
        general = {
            gaps_in = 8,
            gaps_out = 10,
            border_size = 2,
            col = {
                active_border = {
                    colors = { "rgba(db9c5eff)", "rgba(e5c07bff)" },
                    angle = 45,
                },
            },
        },
        decoration = {
            rounding = 12,
            blur = {
                enabled = true,
                size = 8,
                passes = 3,
            },
        },
    })

    -- 4. Blur background untuk Waybar
    pcall(function()
        hl.layer_rule({ match = { namespace = "waybar" }, blur = true, ignore_alpha = 0.2 })
    end)
end

```
#!/usr/bin/env bash

# ==============================================================================
# RENAISSANCE OS : THEME & KEYBIND TOGGLER
# Mengalihkan desktop host antara mode normal dan Renaissance OS (Waybar Masterpiece)
# Tanpa merusak file konfigurasi asli apapun!
# ==============================================================================

STATE_FILE="/tmp/renaissance_mode_active"
ASSETS_DIR="/home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets"
WAYBAR_CONF="$ASSETS_DIR/dotfiles/waybar/config.jsonc"
WAYBAR_STYLE="$ASSETS_DIR/dotfiles/waybar/style.css"
WALLPAPER="$ASSETS_DIR/wallpapers/school_of_athens.jpg"

enable_renaissance() {
    echo "🏛 Mengaktifkan Mode Renaissance OS..."

    # 1. Pasang Flag State Aktif
    touch "$STATE_FILE"

    # 2. Matikan instance Quickshell & Waybar lama
    killall -9 qs quickshell 2>/dev/null
    pkill -x waybar 2>/dev/null

    # 3. Pasang Wallpaper Klasik School of Athens via swaybg
    pkill -x swaybg 2>/dev/null
    swaybg -i "$WALLPAPER" -m fill &

    # 4. Reload Hyprland untuk mengaktifkan keybinds & estetika Renaissance OS
    hyprctl reload

    # 5. Jalankan daemon notifikasi swaync (Control Center) bila belum berjalan
    if ! pgrep -x swaync >/dev/null; then
        swaync &
    fi

    # 6. Nyalakan Waybar Renaissance Masterpiece
    waybar -c "$WAYBAR_CONF" -s "$WAYBAR_STYLE" &

    notify-send "🏛 Renaissance OS" "Mode Digital Humanism Aktif!\n• Super+Space / Super+D : Rofi Launcher\n• Super+K / Ctrl+Super+T : Wallpaper Selector\n• Super+A : Control Center\nJalankan script lagi untuk kembali." -i "$WALLPAPER"
    echo "Mode Renaissance OS Aktif!"
}

disable_renaissance() {
    echo "🔄 Mengembalikan desktop ke profil semula..."

    # 1. Hapus Flag State
    rm -f "$STATE_FILE"

    # 2. Matikan Waybar, swaybg, dan swaync
    pkill -x waybar 2>/dev/null
    pkill -x swaybg 2>/dev/null
    pkill -x swaync 2>/dev/null

    # 3. Reload config Hyprland asli (mengembalikan keybinds dan estetika host)
    hyprctl reload

    # 4. Hidupkan kembali Quickshell bawaan host
    qs -c ii -d &

    notify-send "Desktop Normal" "Desktop & keybinds telah dikembalikan ke konfigurasi asli."
    echo "Desktop telah dikembalikan!"
}

# Toggle Logic
if [ -f "$STATE_FILE" ]; then
    disable_renaissance
else
    enable_renaissance
fi
```

// WAYBAR CONFIGURATION: RENAISSANCE OS (ACADEMIC HUMANIST)

{
    "layer": "top",
    "position": "top",
    "height": 34,
    "margin-top": 0,
    "margin-left": -1,
    "margin-right": -1,
    "spacing": 0,
    "exclusive": true,
    "passthrough": false,
    "gtk-layer-shell": true,
    "reload_style_on_change": true,

    "modules-left": [
        "custom/logo",
        "hyprland/workspaces",
        "custom/separator-left",
        "hyprland/window"
    ],

    "modules-center": [
        "custom/motto"
    ],

    "modules-right": [
        "pulseaudio",
        "battery",
        "custom/separator-right",
        "clock"
    ],

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. SISI KIRI
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    "custom/logo": {
        "format": "󰣇",
        "tooltip": true,
        "tooltip-format": "Renaissance OS · Digital Humanism"
    },

    "hyprland/workspaces": {
        "disable-scroll": true,
        "all-outputs": true,
        "on-click": "activate",
        "format": "{icon}",
        "format-icons": {
            "1": "I",
            "2": "II",
            "3": "III",
            "4": "IV",
            "5": "V",
            "6": "VI",
            "7": "VII",
            "8": "VIII",
            "9": "IX",
            "10": "X",
            "default": "{name}"
        },
        "persistent-workspaces": {
            "*": 4
        }
    },

    "custom/separator-left": {
        "format": "│",
        "tooltip": false
    },

    "hyprland/window": {
        "format": "{title}",
        "max-length": 42,
        "separate-outputs": true,
        "rewrite": {
            "^$": "School of Athens"
        }
    },

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. SISI TENGAH
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    "custom/motto": {
        "format": "Digital Humanism",
        "tooltip": true,
        "tooltip-format": "<b>Digital Humanism & The Renaissance of Open Source</b>\n<i>\"Kedaulatan Individu, Rasionalitas, dan Pengetahuan Bebas\"</i>"
    },

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. SISI KANAN (Esensial: Audio, Baterai, Waktu)
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    "pulseaudio": {
        "format": "{icon}  {volume}%",
        "format-muted": "󰝟  Muted",
        "format-icons": {
            "headphone": "󰋋",
            "hands-free": "󰋋",
            "headset": "󰋋",
            "phone": "󰏲",
            "portable": "󰏲",
            "car": "󰄋",
            "default": ["󰕿", "󰖀", "󰕾"]
        },
        "scroll-step": 5,
        "on-click": "pactl set-sink-mute @DEFAULT_SINK@ toggle",
        "tooltip-format": "Volume: {volume}%\nSink: {desc}"
    },

    "battery": {
        "interval": 10,
        "states": {
            "warning": 30,
            "critical": 15
        },
        "format": "{icon}  {capacity}%",
        "format-charging": "󰂄  {capacity}%",
        "format-plugged": "󰂄  {capacity}%",
        "format-icons": ["󰁺", "󰁼", "󰁾", "󰂀", "󰁹"],
        "tooltip-format": "{timeTo}\nDaya: {power} W"
    },

    "custom/separator-right": {
        "format": "│",
        "tooltip": false
    },

    "clock": {
        "interval": 1,
        "format": "{0:%a, %d %b  %H:%M}",
        "tooltip-format": "<tt><small>{calendar}</small></tt>",
        "calendar": {
            "mode": "month",
            "mode-mon-col": 3,
            "weeks-pos": "right",
            "on-scroll": 1,
            "format": {
                "months": "<span color='#db9c5e'><b>{}</b></span>",
                "days": "<span color='#d3c6aa'>{}</span>",
                "weeks": "<span color='#9d9a85'>W{}</span>",
                "weekdays": "<span color='#e5c07b'><b>{}</b></span>",
                "today": "<span color='#1c2124' bgcolor='#e5c07b'><b>{}</b></span>"
            }
        }
    }
}

```
#!/usr/bin/env bash

# ==============================================================================
# RENAISSANCE OS : THEME & KEYBIND TOGGLER
# Mengalihkan desktop host antara mode normal dan Renaissance OS (Waybar Masterpiece)
# Tanpa merusak file konfigurasi asli apapun!
# ==============================================================================

STATE_FILE="/tmp/renaissance_mode_active"
ASSETS_DIR="/home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets"
WAYBAR_CONF="$ASSETS_DIR/dotfiles/waybar/config.jsonc"
WAYBAR_STYLE="$ASSETS_DIR/dotfiles/waybar/style.css"
WALLPAPER="$ASSETS_DIR/wallpapers/school_of_athens.jpg"

enable_renaissance() {
    echo "🏛 Mengaktifkan Mode Renaissance OS..."

    # 1. Pasang Flag State Aktif
    touch "$STATE_FILE"

    # 2. Matikan instance Quickshell & Waybar lama
    killall -9 qs quickshell 2>/dev/null
    pkill -x waybar 2>/dev/null

    # 3. Pasang Wallpaper Klasik School of Athens via swaybg
    pkill -x swaybg 2>/dev/null
    nohup swaybg -i "$WALLPAPER" -m fill >/dev/null 2>&1 &
    disown

    # 4. Reload Hyprland untuk mengaktifkan keybinds & estetika Renaissance OS
    hyprctl reload

    # 5. Nyalakan Waybar Renaissance Masterpiece
    nohup waybar -c "$WAYBAR_CONF" -s "$WAYBAR_STYLE" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
    disown

    notify-send "🏛 Renaissance OS" "Mode Digital Humanism Aktif!\n• Super+Space / Super+D : Rofi Launcher\n• Super+K / Ctrl+Super+T : Wallpaper Selector\n• Super+A : Control Center\nJalankan script lagi untuk kembali." -i "$WALLPAPER" 2>/dev/null || true
    echo "Mode Renaissance OS Aktif!"
}

disable_renaissance() {
    echo "🔄 Mengembalikan desktop ke profil semula..."

    # 1. Hapus Flag State
    rm -f "$STATE_FILE"

    # 2. Matikan Waybar dan swaybg
    pkill -x waybar 2>/dev/null
    pkill -x swaybg 2>/dev/null

    # 3. Reload config Hyprland asli (mengembalikan keybinds dan estetika host)
    hyprctl reload

    # 4. Hidupkan kembali Quickshell bawaan host
    nohup qs -c ii -d >/dev/null 2>&1 &
    disown

    notify-send "Desktop Normal" "Desktop & keybinds telah dikembalikan ke konfigurasi asli." 2>/dev/null || true
    echo "Desktop telah dikembalikan!"
}

# Toggle Logic
if [ -f "$STATE_FILE" ]; then
    disable_renaissance
else
    enable_renaissance
fi

```

## Assistant

Penyebab mengapa Rofi tidak muncul saat masuk ke mode Renaissance telah ditemukan dan diperbaiki.

---

### 🔍 Penyebab Masalah (Root Cause Analysis)

1. **Hyprland Berbasis Konfigurasi Lua (`hyprland.lua`)**:
   - Sistem host Anda menggunakan Hyprland v0.57.0 dengan konfigurasi Lua native (`hl.*`), bukan format konfigurasi hyprlang klasik.
   - Perintah lama di skrip seperti `hyprctl keyword general:gaps_in ...` gagal dengan pesan `unknown request`.
2. **Tidak Adanya `hyprctl reload` saat Mode Diaktifkan**:
   - Di [toggle_renaissance.sh](file:///home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/toggle_renaissance.sh), saat mengaktifkan mode (`enable_renaissance`), skrip mematikan Quickshell (`killall -9 qs quickshell`), tetapi **tidak memanggil `hyprctl reload`**.
   - Akibatnya, Hyprland masih memegang keybind lama di mana <kbd>Super</kbd> + <kbd>Space</kbd> diarahkan ke dispatcher `quickshell:searchToggleRelease`. Karena proses Quickshell sudah dimatikan, shortcut tersebut memanggil proses mati sehingga tidak ada yang tampil.
   - Shortcut <kbd>Super</kbd> + <kbd>D</kbd> di konfigurasi default host Anda terikat ke `togglesplit` (bukan Rofi).

---

### 🛠️ Perbaikan yang Telah Diterapkan

1. **Integrasi Dinamis Lua di `~/.config/hypr/hyprland/shellOverrides/main.lua`**:
   - Menambahkan `hl.unbind()` untuk membersihkan shortcut lama yang berkonflik (<kbd>Super</kbd>+<kbd>Space</kbd>, <kbd>Super</kbd>+<kbd>D</kbd>, <kbd>Super</kbd>+<kbd>A</kbd>, <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Super</kbd>+<kbd>T</kbd>, dll.).
   - Mendaftarkan keybind Renaissance OS:
     - <kbd>Super</kbd> + <kbd>Space</kbd> &rarr; Rofi Application Launcher (`renaissance_launcher.rasi`)
     - <kbd>Super</kbd> + <kbd>D</kbd> &rarr; Rofi Application Launcher (`renaissance_launcher.rasi`)
     - <kbd>Super</kbd> + <kbd>K</kbd> / <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Super</kbd> + <kbd>T</kbd> &rarr; Rofi Wallpaper Selector
     - <kbd>Super</kbd> + <kbd>V</kbd> &rarr; Rofi Clipboard History
   - Menerapkan estetika tema Renaissance OS langsung via API Lua (`hl.config`): sudut membulat 12px, Kawase blur, gaps 8/10, dan border emas klasik `#db9c5e`.
2. **Pembaruan Skrip [toggle_renaissance.sh](file:///home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/toggle_renaissance.sh)**:
   - Menambahkan eksekusi `hyprctl reload` pada fungsi `enable_renaissance()` agar Hyprland langsung memuat binding & estetika baru tanpa perlu restart session.
   - Menjalankan `swaybg` dan `waybar` dengan `nohup` dan `disown` agar proses tetap berjalan stabil di latar belakang.
3. **Pintasan Mouse di Waybar [config.jsonc](file:///home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/dotfiles/waybar/config.jsonc)**:
   - Menambahkan event `"on-click"` pada modul `"custom/logo"` (ikon Arch di pojok kiri atas). Anda sekarang juga dapat mengklik ikon tersebut untuk membuka Rofi launcher secara instan.

---

### 🚀 Cara Mencoba

Jalankan perintah toggle seperti biasa:
```bash
/home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/toggle_renaissance.sh
```

- Tekan <kbd>Super</kbd> + <kbd>Space</kbd> atau <kbd>Super</kbd> + <kbd>D</kbd> &rarr; Rofi Launcher bertema Renaissance akan langsung muncul di tengah layar.
- Jalankan skrip sekali lagi &rarr; desktop host Anda beserta Quickshell dan seluruh keybind bawaan akan dikembalikan 100% seperti semula.

#!/usr/bin/env bash

# ==============================================================================
# RENAISSANCE OS : ROFI WALLPAPER SELECTOR
# ==============================================================================

WALL_DIR="/home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/wallpapers"
THEME_RASI="/home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/dotfiles/rofi/wallpaper_grid.rasi"

if [ ! -d "$WALL_DIR" ]; then
    notify-send "Wallpaper Error" "Direktori wallpaper tidak ditemukan"
    exit 1
fi

# Buat format input untuk rofi dmenu dengan thumbnail icon
ENTRY_LIST=""
for img in "$WALL_DIR"/*.{jpg,jpeg,png}; do
    [ -e "$img" ] || continue
    filename=$(basename "$img")
    title="${filename%.*}"
    # Format: Nama Tampilan\0icon\x1f/path/to/image
    ENTRY_LIST+="$title\0icon\x1f$img\n"
done

CHOSEN=$(echo -en "$ENTRY_LIST" | rofi -dmenu -theme "$THEME_RASI" -p "🏛 Lukisan Klasik")

if [ -n "$CHOSEN" ]; then
    SELECTED_PATH=$(find "$WALL_DIR" -type f -name "${CHOSEN}.*" | head -n 1)
    if [ -f "$SELECTED_PATH" ]; then
        # Terapkan ke Hyprland via hyprctl hyprpaper atau swww / swaybg
        if command -v swww &>/dev/null; then
            swww img "$SELECTED_PATH" --transition-type wipe --transition-duration 1.5
        elif command -v hyprctl &>/dev/null && pgrep -x hyprpaper >/dev/null; then
            hyprctl hyprpaper preload "$SELECTED_PATH"
            hyprctl hyprpaper wallpaper ",$SELECTED_PATH"
            hyprctl hyprpaper unload all >/dev/null 2>&1
        elif command -v swaybg &>/dev/null; then
            pkill -x swaybg 2>/dev/null
            swaybg -i "$SELECTED_PATH" -m fill &
        fi
        notify-send "Renaissance OS" "Wallpaper diterapkan: $CHOSEN" -i "$SELECTED_PATH"
    fi
fi

/**
 * RENAISSANCE OS : ROFI WALLPAPER SELECTOR GRID
 * Visual Grid Layout: 2 Rows x 4 Columns thumbnail cards
 */

* {
    font: "Cinzel 11";
    bg-base: rgba(35, 42, 46, 0.95);
    bg-card: rgba(45, 53, 59, 0.85);
    bg-active: rgba(219, 156, 94, 0.25);
    border-gold: #db9c5e;
    fg-main: #d3c6aa;
    fg-bright: #f4e8c1;
    fg-muted: #859289;

    background-color: transparent;
    text-color: @fg-main;
    margin: 0px;
    padding: 0px;
}

window {
    width: 960px;
    background-color: @bg-base;
    border: 2px;
    border-color: @border-gold;
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 24px;
    location: center;
    anchor: center;
}

mainbox {
    children: [ inputbar, listview ];
    spacing: 20px;
}

inputbar {
    background-color: @bg-card;
    border: 1px;
    border-color: @border-gold;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 10px 16px;
    children: [ prompt, entry ];
    spacing: 12px;
}

prompt {
    font: "Cinzel 12";
    text-color: @border-gold;
}

entry {
    placeholder: "Pilih lukisan klasik Renaissance...";
    placeholder-color: @fg-muted;
    text-color: @fg-bright;
}

listview {
    layout: vertical;
    lines: 2;
    columns: 4;
    cycle: true;
    dynamic: true;
    spacing: 16px;
    flow: horizontal;
}

element {
    orientation: vertical;
    padding: 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background-color: @bg-card;
    border: 1px;
    border-color: rgba(219, 156, 94, 0.25);
    spacing: 8px;
    children: [ element-icon, element-text ];
}

element selected.normal {
    background-color: @bg-active;
    border: 2px;
    border-color: @border-gold;
    text-color: @fg-bright;
}

element-icon {
    size: 130px;
    horizontal-align: 0.5;
    border-radius: 6px;
}

element-text {
    font: "EB Garamond 12";
    horizontal-align: 0.5;
    text-color: inherit;
}

```
#!/usr/bin/env bash

# ==============================================================================
# RENAISSANCE OS : ROFI WALLPAPER SELECTOR
# Standardized Classical Art Selector (English Interface)
# ==============================================================================

WALL_DIR="/home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/wallpapers"
THEME_RASI="/home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/dotfiles/rofi/wallpaper_grid.rasi"

if [ ! -d "$WALL_DIR" ]; then
    notify-send "Wallpaper Error" "Wallpaper directory not found"
    exit 1
fi

# Build input list for rofi dmenu with artwork title and thumbnail icon
ENTRY_LIST=""
format_title() {
    case "$1" in
        "birth_of_venus") echo "The Birth of Venus" ;;
        "mona_lisa") echo "Mona Lisa" ;;
        "school_of_athens") echo "The School of Athens" ;;
        "the_creation_of_adam") echo "The Creation of Adam" ;;
        *)
            # Fallback formatting: replace underscores with spaces and capitalize
            echo "$1" | sed -r 's/(^|_)([a-z])/\U \2/g' | sed 's/^ //'
            ;;
    esac
}

for img in "$WALL_DIR"/*.{jpg,jpeg,png}; do
    [ -e "$img" ] || continue
    filename=$(basename "$img")
    stem="${filename%.*}"
    title=$(format_title "$stem")
    # Format: Display Title\0icon\x1f/path/to/image
    ENTRY_LIST+="$title\0icon\x1f$img\n"
done

CHOSEN=$(echo -en "$ENTRY_LIST" | rofi -dmenu -theme "$THEME_RASI" -p "🏛 Classical Art")

if [ -n "$CHOSEN" ]; then
    # Map title back to filename
    case "$CHOSEN" in
        "The Birth of Venus"|"birth_of_venus") stem="birth_of_venus" ;;
        "Mona Lisa"|"mona_lisa") stem="mona_lisa" ;;
        "The School of Athens"|"school_of_athens") stem="school_of_athens" ;;
        "The Creation of Adam"|"the_creation_of_adam") stem="the_creation_of_adam" ;;
        *) stem=$(echo "$CHOSEN" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | tr ' ' '_') ;;
    esac

    SELECTED_PATH=$(find "$WALL_DIR" -type f -name "${stem}.*" | head -n 1)

    if [ -f "$SELECTED_PATH" ]; then
        # Apply wallpaper to Hyprland via swww, hyprpaper, or swaybg
        if command -v swww &>/dev/null; then
            swww img "$SELECTED_PATH" --transition-type wipe --transition-duration 1.5
        elif command -v hyprctl &>/dev/null && pgrep -x hyprpaper >/dev/null; then
            hyprctl hyprpaper preload "$SELECTED_PATH"
            hyprctl hyprpaper wallpaper ",$SELECTED_PATH"
            hyprctl hyprpaper unload all >/dev/null 2>&1
        elif command -v swaybg &>/dev/null; then
            pkill -x swaybg 2>/dev/null
            swaybg -i "$SELECTED_PATH" -m fill &
        fi
        notify-send "Renaissance OS" "Wallpaper applied: $CHOSEN" -i "$SELECTED_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
fi

```

```
#!/usr/bin/env bash

# ==============================================================================
# RENAISSANCE OS : ROFI WALLPAPER SELECTOR
# Standardized Classical Art Selector (English Interface)
# ==============================================================================

WALL_DIR="/home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/wallpapers"
THEME_RASI="/home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/dotfiles/rofi/wallpaper_grid.rasi"

if [ ! -d "$WALL_DIR" ]; then
    notify-send "Wallpaper Error" "Wallpaper directory not found"
    exit 1
fi

# Build input list for rofi dmenu with artwork title and thumbnail icon
ENTRY_LIST=""
format_title() {
    case "$1" in
        "birth_of_venus") echo "The Birth of Venus" ;;
        "mona_lisa") echo "Mona Lisa" ;;
        "school_of_athens") echo "The School of Athens" ;;
        "the_creation_of_adam") echo "The Creation of Adam" ;;
        *)
            # Fallback formatting: replace underscores with spaces and capitalize
            echo "$1" | sed -r 's/(^|_)([a-z])/\U \2/g' | sed 's/^ //'
            ;;
    esac
}

for img in "$WALL_DIR"/*.{jpg,jpeg,png}; do
    [ -e "$img" ] || continue
    filename=$(basename "$img")
    stem="${filename%.*}"
    title=$(format_title "$stem")
    # Format: Display Title\0icon\x1f/path/to/image
    ENTRY_LIST+="$title\0icon\x1f$img\n"
done

CHOSEN=$(echo -en "$ENTRY_LIST" | rofi -dmenu -theme "$THEME_RASI" -p "📁")

if [ -n "$CHOSEN" ]; then
    # Map title back to filename
    case "$CHOSEN" in
        "The Birth of Venus"|"birth_of_venus") stem="birth_of_venus" ;;
        "Mona Lisa"|"mona_lisa") stem="mona_lisa" ;;
        "The School of Athens"|"school_of_athens") stem="school_of_athens" ;;
        "The Creation of Adam"|"the_creation_of_adam") stem="the_creation_of_adam" ;;
        *) stem=$(echo "$CHOSEN" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | tr ' ' '_') ;;
    esac

    SELECTED_PATH=$(find "$WALL_DIR" -type f -name "${stem}.*" | head -n 1)

    if [ -f "$SELECTED_PATH" ]; then
        # Apply wallpaper to Hyprland via swww, hyprpaper, or swaybg
        if command -v swww &>/dev/null; then
            swww img "$SELECTED_PATH" --transition-type wipe --transition-duration 1.5
        elif command -v hyprctl &>/dev/null && pgrep -x hyprpaper >/dev/null; then
            hyprctl hyprpaper preload "$SELECTED_PATH"
            hyprctl hyprpaper wallpaper ",$SELECTED_PATH"
            hyprctl hyprpaper unload all >/dev/null 2>&1
        elif command -v swaybg &>/dev/null; then
            pkill -x swaybg 2>/dev/null
            swaybg -i "$SELECTED_PATH" -m fill &
        fi
        notify-send "Renaissance OS" "Wallpaper applied: $CHOSEN" -i "$SELECTED_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
fi
```

```
# ==============================================================================
# RENAISSANCE OS : HYPRLAND CONFIGURATION
# Tema: Digital Humanism & The Renaissance of Open Source
# Sesuai Mockup: Rounded Corners 12px, Kawase Blur, Border Emas #db9c5e
# ==============================================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. MONITOR & ENVIRONMENT (AMAN UNTUK HOST MAUPUN VIRTUALBOX)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
monitor=,preferred,auto,1

# Safe rendering flags (Wajib agar tidak crash/black screen di VirtualBox/VM)
cursor {
    no_hardware_cursors = true
}
env = WLR_NO_HARDWARE_CURSORS,1
env = WLR_RENDERER_ALLOW_SOFTWARE,1
env = XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP,Hyprland
env = XDG_SESSION_TYPE,wayland
env = XDG_SESSION_DESKTOP,Hyprland

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. EKSEKUSI OTOMATIS (AUTOSTART)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
exec-once = waybar -c /home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/dotfiles/waybar/config.jsonc -s /home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/dotfiles/waybar/style.css
exec-once = swaybg -i /home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/wallpapers/school_of_athens.jpg -m fill
exec-once = wl-paste --watch cliphist store
exec-once = swaync

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. TAMPILAN, SUDUT MEMBULAT, & BLUR (PERSIS MOCKUP)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
general {
    gaps_in = 8
    gaps_out = 10
    border_size = 2
    col.active_border = rgb(db9c5e) rgb(e5c07b) 45deg
    col.inactive_border = rgba(45535bcc)

    layout = dwindle
    resize_on_border = true
}

decoration {
    rounding = 12

    active_opacity = 0.92
    inactive_opacity = 0.82
    fullscreen_opacity = 1.0

    shadow {
        enabled = true
        range = 20
        render_power = 3
        color = rgba(1a1e2188)
        color_inactive = rgba(10141666)
    }

    blur {
        enabled = true
        size = 8
        passes = 3
        new_optimizations = true
        xray = false
        noise = 0.02
        contrast = 0.95
        brightness = 0.90
        vibrancy = 0.25
    }
}

animations {
    enabled = true
    bezier = renaissance, 0.16, 1, 0.3, 1
    animation = windows, 1, 4, renaissance, slide
    animation = windowsOut, 1, 4, renaissance, slide
    animation = border, 1, 6, default
    animation = fade, 1, 3, default
    animation = workspaces, 1, 4, renaissance, slide
}

dwindle {
    pseudotile = true
    preserve_split = true
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. LAYER RULES (BLUR WAYBAR & ROFI)

layerrule = blur, waybar
layerrule = ignorealpha 0.2, waybar

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. KEYBINDS (100% PERSIS KEBIASAAN JARIMU)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
$mainMod = SUPER

bind = $mainMod, T, exec, kitty --config /home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/dotfiles/kitty/kitty.conf -1
bind = CTRL ALT, T, exec, kitty --config /home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/dotfiles/kitty/kitty.conf -1
bind = $mainMod, Q, killactive
```

## Assistant

Efek blur backdrop dan panel solid untuk kedua menu Rofi (baik **Wallpaper Selector** maupun **App Launcher**) telah berhasil diterapkan:

---

### 🎨 Detail Perubahan Sesuai Referensi Gambar

1. **Efek Blur Tipis pada Latar Belakang (Backdrop Depth of Field)**:
   - Window Rofi kini melingkupi seluruh layar (*fullscreen layer surface*) dengan *tint* lembut semi-transparan (`rgba(18, 22, 25, 0.40)`).
   - Melalui layer-rule Hyprland (`blur = true, ignore_alpha = 0.05` pada *namespace* `rofi`), seluruh wallpaper desktop di belakang modal Rofi otomatis mendapatkan efek **Kawase Blur lembut** persis seperti pada tangkapan layar referensi Anda.

2. **Panel Rofi Lebih Solid & Terlindung (Frosted Acrylic Effect)**:
   - Kotak modal tengah (*mainbox*) tidak lagi transparan tipis, melainkan menggunakan warna dasar gelap solid bertingkat:
     - **Wallpaper Grid**: `rgba(32, 38, 42, 0.94)` dengan padding 24px dan sudut membulat 16px.
     - **App Launcher**: `rgba(30, 36, 40, 0.94)` dengan sudut membulat 14px.
   - Dilengkapi aksen *border* emas klasik Renaissance (`#db9c5e`) setebal 1.5px.
   - Konten teks, thumbnail karya seni, dan ikon aplikasi menjadi sangat tegas, kontras, dan nyaman dibaca tanpa terdistorsi oleh elemen di balik layar.

3. **Input Bar Pencarian Presisi**:
   - Kotak input pencarian dihiasi ikon folder `📁` dan teks placeholder:
     ```
     📁 Search / Choose Renaissance Wallpaper
     ```
   - *Border* input beraksen emas halus `rgba(219, 156, 94, 0.60)` dengan sudut membulat 10px.

---

- <kbd>Super</kbd> + <kbd>K</kbd> atau <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Super</kbd> + <kbd>T</kbd> &rarr; Membuka **Wallpaper Selector** dengan efek blur penuh.
- <kbd>Super</kbd> + <kbd>Space</kbd> atau <kbd>Super</kbd> + <kbd>D</kbd> &rarr; Membuka **App Launcher** dengan efek blur penuh.

/**
 * =============================================================================
 * RENAISSANCE OS : ROFI WALLPAPER SELECTOR GRID
 * Visual Grid Layout: 2 Rows x 4 Columns thumbnail cards
 * Fullscreen Subtle Backdrop Blur with Solid Frosted-Glass Modal Box
 * =============================================================================
 */

* {
    font: "Cinzel 11";
    bg-dim: rgba(18, 22, 25, 0.40);
    bg-base: rgba(32, 38, 42, 0.94);
    bg-card: rgba(45, 53, 59, 0.85);
    bg-active: rgba(219, 156, 94, 0.25);
    border-gold: #db9c5e;
    border-subtle: rgba(219, 156, 94, 0.60);
    fg-main: #d3c6aa;
    fg-bright: #f4e8c1;
    fg-muted: #859289;

    background-color: transparent;
    text-color: @fg-main;
    margin: 0px;
    padding: 0px;
}

window {
    fullscreen: true;
    transparency: "real";
    background-color: @bg-dim;
    children: [ dummy-top, center-box, dummy-bottom ];
}

center-box {
    orientation: horizontal;
    children: [ dummy-left, mainbox, dummy-right ];
}

mainbox {
    width: 960px;
    background-color: @bg-base;
    border: 1.5px;
    border-color: @border-gold;
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 24px;
    children: [ inputbar, listview ];
    spacing: 20px;
}

inputbar {
    background-color: rgba(24, 29, 32, 0.85);
    border: 1px;
    border-color: @border-subtle;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 10px 16px;
    children: [ prompt, entry ];
    spacing: 12px;
}

prompt {
    font: "Cinzel 12";
    text-color: @border-gold;
}

entry {
    placeholder: "Search / Choose Renaissance Wallpaper";
    placeholder-color: @fg-muted;
    text-color: @fg-bright;
    font: "EB Garamond 12";
}

listview {
    layout: vertical;
    lines: 2;
    columns: 4;
    cycle: true;
    dynamic: true;
    spacing: 16px;
    flow: horizontal;
}

element {
    orientation: vertical;
    padding: 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background-color: @bg-card;
    border: 1px;
    border-color: rgba(219, 156, 94, 0.25);
    spacing: 8px;
    children: [ element-icon, element-text ];
}

element selected.normal {
    background-color: @bg-active;
    border: 2px;
    border-color: @border-gold;
    text-color: @fg-bright;
}

element-icon {
    size: 130px;
    horizontal-align: 0.5;
    border-radius: 8px;
}

element-text {
    font: "EB Garamond 12";
    horizontal-align: 0.5;
    text-color: inherit;
}

```
    text-color: @fg-main;
}

element alternate.normal {

    text-color: @fg-main;

    border-color: @border-gold;
    border-radius: 8px;
}

element-icon {
    size: 38px;
    vertical-align: 0.5;
    cursor: inherit;
}

element-text {
    vertical-align: 0.5;
    text-color: inherit;
    cursor: inherit;
}
```

## Assistant

Seluruh penyesuaian telah selesai dan dimuat ulang (*reloaded*) secara langsung:

---

### 1. Bentuk Panel Dikembalikan 100% (Simetris & Proporsional)
- Struktur *fullscreen dummy widget* yang sebelumnya membuat layout Rofi terbagi secara tidak seimbang dan memotong kartu telah dihapus.
- Bentuk modal dipulihkan ke arsitektur aslinya di [`wallpaper_grid.rasi`](file:///home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/dotfiles/rofi/wallpaper_grid.rasi):
  - Lebar modal presisi: `width: 960px` di tengah layar (`location: center; anchor: center`).
  - Grid 2 baris × 4 kolom kartu lukisan kembali tampil simetris, lega, rapi, dan tidak ada yang terpotong.
  - Hal serupa juga diterapkan pada [`renaissance_launcher.rasi`](file:///home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/dotfiles/rofi/renaissance_launcher.rasi) (`width: 530px`).

---

### 2. Pengaturan Blur Sangat Tipis & Panel Solid
Mengenai pertanyaan Anda (*apakah tidak bisa / apakah terbatas?*):
> **Tentu saja bisa dan tidak terbatas!** Di Hyprland, ketebalan efek blur diatur melalui parameter `size` (radius) dan `passes` (iterasi algoritma Kawase Blur).

- **Sebelumnya**: Menggunakan `size = 8, passes = 3` (menghasilkan blur tebal/pekat).
- **Sekarang**: Telah disesuaikan menjadi **`size = 4, passes = 1`** (*single-pass subtle blur*).
  - Menghasilkan efek blur yang **sangat tipis, halus, dan jernih** persis seperti efek kedalaman fotografi pada gambar referensi Anda.
- **Panel Lebih Solid**:
  - Warna dasar panel Rofi menggunakan `rgba(28, 33, 37, 0.92)` dengan kartu `rgba(45, 53, 59, 0.85)`. Panel kini berbobot gelap solid (tidak tembus pandang mentah), dengan bias blur tipis yang menyatu di belakangnya serta bingkai emas klasik `#db9c5e`.

---

Anda dapat langsung mencobanya di desktop Anda dengan menekan <kbd>Super</kbd> + <kbd>K</kbd> (Wallpaper) atau <kbd>Super</kbd> + <kbd>Space</kbd> (Launcher).

import urllib.request, json

def get_wiki_img(query):
    url = f'https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&format=json&generator=search&gsrsearch={query}&gsrlimit=1&prop=imageinfo&iiprop=url'
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'RenaissanceOS/1.0'})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
            data = json.loads(resp.read().decode('utf-8'))
            pages = data['query']['pages']
            for k, v in pages.items():
                return v['imageinfo'][0]['url']
    except Exception as e:
        return str(e)

print('Vitruvian:', get_wiki_img('File:Da_Vinci_Vitruve_Luc_Viatour.jpg'))
print('Last Supper:', get_wiki_img('File:The_Last_Supper_-_Leonardo_Da_Vinci_-_High_Resolution_32x16.jpg'))
print('Classical Ruins:', get_wiki_img('File:Giovanni_Paolo_Panini_-_Capriccio_of_Roman_Ruins.jpg'))
print('School of Athens / Greek Library:', get_wiki_img('File:Sanzio_01.jpg'))
"**

import urllib.request, json, subprocess

def download_file(search_term, out_name):
    url = f'https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&format=json&generator=search&gsrsearch={urllib.parse.quote(search_term)}&gsrnamespace=6&gsrlimit=1&prop=imageinfo&iiprop=url'
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'TubesSO/1.0 (rifqi@example.com)'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        d = json.loads(resp.read().decode('utf-8'))
        for p in d['query']['pages'].values():
            img_url = p['imageinfo'][0]['url']
            print(f'Downloading {out_name} from {img_url}...')
            req2 = urllib.request.Request(img_url, headers={'User-Agent': 'TubesSO/1.0 (rifqi@example.com)'})
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req2) as r2, open(f'assets/wallpapers/{out_name}', 'wb') as f:
                f.write(r2.read())
            subprocess.run(['magick', f'assets/wallpapers/{out_name}', '-resize', '1920x1200^', '-gravity', 'center', '-extent', '1920x1200', '-quality', '95', f'assets/wallpapers/{out_name}'], check=True)
            print(f'{out_name} done!')
            return

download_file('Giovanni Paolo Pannini Roman Ruins', 'classical_ruins.jpg')
download_file('Raphael Disputation of the Most Holy Sacrament', 'ancient_greek_library.jpg')

```
#!/usr/bin/env bash

# ==============================================================================
# RENAISSANCE OS : ROFI WALLPAPER SELECTOR
# Standardized Classical Art Selector (Faithful Mockup Layout)
# ==============================================================================

WALL_DIR="/home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/wallpapers"
THUMB_DIR="$WALL_DIR/.thumbs"
THEME_RASI="/home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/dotfiles/rofi/wallpaper_grid.rasi"

if [ ! -d "$WALL_DIR" ]; then
    notify-send "Wallpaper Error" "Wallpaper directory not found"
    exit 1
fi

mkdir -p "$THUMB_DIR"

# Definisi 8 karya seni klasik Renaissance persis urutan mockup
ITEMS=(
    "the_creation_of_adam:The Creation of Adam"
    "mona_lisa:Mona Lisa"
    "vitruvian_man:Vitruvian Man"
    "birth_of_venus:The Birth of Venus"
    "ancient_greek_library:Ancient Greek Library"
    "the_last_supper:The Last Supper"
    "classical_ruins:Classical Ruins"
    "school_of_athens:The School of Athens"
)

ENTRY_LIST=""
for item in "${ITEMS[@]}"; do
    stem="${item%%:*}"
    title="${item#*:}"
    img="$WALL_DIR/${stem}.jpg"
    thumb="$THUMB_DIR/${stem}.jpg"

    [ -f "$img" ] || continue

    # Buat thumbnail jika belum ada
    if [ ! -f "$thumb" ]; then
        magick "$img" -resize 360x270^ -gravity center -extent 360x270 -quality 95 "$thumb" 2>/dev/null
    fi

    icon_to_use="$thumb"
    [ -f "$icon_to_use" ] || icon_to_use="$img"

    # Format Rofi dmenu: Title\0icon\x1fPath
    ENTRY_LIST+="$title\0icon\x1f$icon_to_use\n"
done

CHOSEN=$(echo -en "$ENTRY_LIST" | rofi -dmenu -theme "$THEME_RASI" -p "📁")

if [ -n "$CHOSEN" ]; then
    # Cari stem yang cocok dengan title
    selected_stem=""
    for item in "${ITEMS[@]}"; do
        stem="${item%%:*}"
        title="${item#*:}"
        if [ "$title" = "$CHOSEN" ] || [ "$stem" = "$CHOSEN" ]; then
            selected_stem="$stem"
            break
        fi
    done

    [ -z "$selected_stem" ] && selected_stem=$(echo "$CHOSEN" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | tr ' ' '_')
    SELECTED_PATH="$WALL_DIR/${selected_stem}.jpg"

    if [ -f "$SELECTED_PATH" ]; then
        # Terapkan wallpaper ke Hyprland
        if command -v swww &>/dev/null; then
            swww img "$SELECTED_PATH" --transition-type wipe --transition-duration 1.5
        elif command -v hyprctl &>/dev/null && pgrep -x hyprpaper >/dev/null; then
            hyprctl hyprpaper preload "$SELECTED_PATH"
            hyprctl hyprpaper wallpaper ",$SELECTED_PATH"
            hyprctl hyprpaper unload all >/dev/null 2>&1
        elif command -v swaybg &>/dev/null; then
            pkill -x swaybg 2>/dev/null
            swaybg -i "$SELECTED_PATH" -m fill &
        fi
        notify-send "Renaissance OS" "Wallpaper applied: $CHOSEN" -i "$SELECTED_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
fi
```

```
/**
 * =============================================================================
 * RENAISSANCE OS : ROFI WALLPAPER SELECTOR GRID
 * Visual Grid Layout: 2 Rows x 4 Columns
 * Desain: Bersih, Humanis Modern (Font Inter), Tanpa Outline Nanggung
 * =============================================================================
 */

* {
    font: "Inter 11";
    bg-base: rgba(28, 33, 37, 0.95);
    bg-card: rgba(42, 50, 56, 0.85);
    bg-active: rgba(219, 156, 94, 0.22);
    border-gold: #db9c5e;
    fg-main: #d3c6aa;
    fg-bright: #fbf2db;
    fg-muted: #859289;

    background-color: transparent;
    text-color: @fg-main;
    margin: 0px;
    padding: 0px;
}

window {
    width: 980px;
    background-color: @bg-base;
    border: 1.5px;
    border-color: @border-gold;
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 24px;
    location: center;
    anchor: center;
}

mainbox {
    children: [ inputbar, listview ];
    spacing: 18px;
}

inputbar {
    background-color: rgba(18, 22, 25, 0.75);
    border: 0px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 12px 18px;
    children: [ prompt, entry ];
    spacing: 12px;
}

prompt {
    font: "Inter 13";
    text-color: @border-gold;
    vertical-align: 0.5;
}

entry {
    placeholder: "Search / Choose Renaissance Wallpaper";
    placeholder-color: @fg-muted;
    text-color: @fg-bright;
    font: "Inter 12";
    vertical-align: 0.5;
}

listview {
    layout: vertical;
    lines: 2;
    columns: 4;
    cycle: true;
    dynamic: false;
    spacing: 16px;
    flow: horizontal;
    fixed-columns: true;
}

element {
    orientation: vertical;
    padding: 6px 6px 12px 6px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background-color: @bg-card;
    border: 0px;
    spacing: 8px;
    children: [ element-icon, element-text ];
}

element selected.normal {
    background-color: @bg-active;
    border: 2px;
    border-color: @border-gold;
}

element-icon {
    size: 195px;
    horizontal-align: 0.5;
    border-radius: 8px;
}

element-text {
    font: "Inter 11";
    horizontal-align: 0.5;
    text-color: #d3c6aa;
}

element selected.normal element-text {
    text-color: #fbf2db;
}
```

### 🛠️ Detail Perubahan yang Diterapkan

1. **Menghilangkan Outline Tipis "Nanggung"**:
   - Seluruh *outline/border* 1px tipis yang kaku pada kotak input pencarian dan kartu yang tidak dipilih telah **dihapus total** (`border: 0px`).
   - Elemen kini menggunakan pendekatan desain permukaan (*clean surface fill & elevation*):
     - Kotak pencarian menggunakan *surface fill* gelap lembut (`rgba(18, 22, 25, 0.75)`) yang menyatu natural.
     - Kartu wallpaper tidak terpilih menggunakan warna dasar bersih (`rgba(42, 50, 56, 0.85)`).
     - *Border* emas tegas (`#db9c5e`) hanya muncul secara eksklusif pada **elemen yang sedang aktif/dipilih**, menghilangkan kesan "wireframe / template kaku".

2. **Standarisasi Font dengan Waybar (`Inter`)**:
   - Menggantikan font monospace `JetBrainsMono` yang kaku pada nama-nama aplikasi dan menggantikan font serif pada grid dengan font **`Inter`**—font humanist modern yang sama persis dengan font utama Waybar Anda (`assets/dotfiles/waybar/style.css`):
     - Input pencarian: `Inter 12.5`
     - Judul aplikasi & judul karya seni: `Inter 12` / `Inter 11`
     - Keterangan aplikasi (*generic name*): `Inter 10`
   - Hasilnya seluruh antarmuka terasa serasi, kohesif, dan nyaman dipandang.

3. **Memperlebar Ukuran Rofi Launcher**:
   - Lebar Rofi Launcher diperbesar dari sebelumnya `530px` menjadi **`700px`** di [`renaissance_launcher.rasi`](file:///home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/dotfiles/rofi/renaissance_launcher.rasi).
   - Jauh lebih proporsional di layar 1920×1200, memberikan ruang baca teks yang luas, dan ikon aplikasi tampil tajam serta berjarak nyaman.

---

Anda dapat langsung mencobanya di desktop:
- <kbd>Super</kbd> + <kbd>Space</kbd> atau <kbd>Super</kbd> + <kbd>D</kbd> &rarr; **App Launcher** (Lebar, bersih, font Inter).
- <kbd>Super</kbd> + <kbd>K</kbd> atau <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Super</kbd> + <kbd>T</kbd> &rarr; **Wallpaper Selector** (8 kartu simetris, preview penuh, bersih tanpa outline nanggung).

**Tool Call: python3 -c "
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageFilter

im = Image.open('assets/wallpapers/candidates/creation_of_adam_hq.jpg').convert('RGB')
target_w, target_h = 1920, 1200

# Scale width to target_w
new_w = target_w
new_h = int(im.height * (target_w / im.width)) # ~870
im_scaled = im.resize((new_w, new_h), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)

# Buat canvas dengan warna rata-rata plester atas dan bawah
# Warna tepi atas
top_strip = np.array(im_scaled.crop((0, 0, new_w, 30)))
top_color = tuple(np.median(top_strip.reshape(-1, 3), axis=0).astype(int))

# Warna tepi bawah
bot_strip = np.array(im_scaled.crop((0, new_h-30, new_w, new_h)))
bot_color = tuple(np.median(bot_strip.reshape(-1, 3), axis=0).astype(int))

offset_y = (target_h - new_h) // 2 # 165

# Buat canvas gradien plester halus
bg = np.zeros((target_h, target_w, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
for y in range(target_h):
    if y < offset_y + 100:
        bg[y, :] = top_color
    elif y > offset_y + new_h - 100:
        bg[y, :] = bot_color
    else:
        # linear interpolate
        t = (y - (offset_y + 100)) / (new_h - 200)
        bg[y, :] = (np.array(top_color)*(1-t) + np.array(bot_color)*t).astype(np.uint8)

bg_img = Image.fromarray(bg).filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(40))

# Mask untuk feather atas dan bawah im_scaled
mask = np.ones((new_h, new_w), dtype=np.float32)
feather = 35
for i in range(feather):
    alpha = (i / feather)
    mask[i, :] = alpha
    mask[new_h - 1 - i, :] = alpha

mask_img = Image.fromarray((mask * 255).astype(np.uint8), mode='L')

bg_img.paste(im_scaled, (0, offset_y), mask_img)
bg_img.save('assets/wallpapers/the_creation_of_adam.jpg', quality=95)
print('Done feather blending')
"**

```
#!/usr/bin/env bash

# ==============================================================================
# RENAISSANCE OS : ROFI WALLPAPER SELECTOR
# Standardized Classical Art Selector (Faithful Mockup Layout)
# ==============================================================================

WALL_DIR="/home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/wallpapers"
THUMB_DIR="$WALL_DIR/.thumbs"
THEME_RASI="/home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/dotfiles/rofi/wallpaper_grid.rasi"

if [ ! -d "$WALL_DIR" ]; then
    notify-send "Wallpaper Error" "Wallpaper directory not found"
    exit 1
fi

mkdir -p "$THUMB_DIR"

# Definisi 8 karya seni klasik Renaissance persis urutan mockup
ITEMS=(
    "the_creation_of_adam:The Creation of Adam"
    "primavera:Primavera"
    "tower_of_babel:The Tower of Babel"
    "birth_of_venus:The Birth of Venus"
    "annunciation:The Annunciation"
    "the_last_supper:The Last Supper"
    "classical_ruins:Classical Ruins"
    "school_of_athens:The School of Athens"
)

ENTRY_LIST=""
for item in "${ITEMS[@]}"; do
    stem="${item%%:*}"
    title="${item#*:}"
    img="$WALL_DIR/${stem}.jpg"
    thumb="$THUMB_DIR/${stem}.jpg"

    [ -f "$img" ] || continue

    # Buat thumbnail jika belum ada
    if [ ! -f "$thumb" ]; then
        magick "$img" -resize 340x260^ -gravity center -extent 340x260 -quality 95 "$thumb" 2>/dev/null
    fi

    icon_to_use="$thumb"
    [ -f "$icon_to_use" ] || icon_to_use="$img"

    # Format Rofi dmenu: Title\0icon\x1fPath
    ENTRY_LIST+="$title\0icon\x1f$icon_to_use\n"
done

CHOSEN=$(echo -en "$ENTRY_LIST" | rofi -dmenu -theme "$THEME_RASI" -p "📁")

if [ -n "$CHOSEN" ]; then
    # Cari stem yang cocok dengan title
    selected_stem=""
    for item in "${ITEMS[@]}"; do
        stem="${item%%:*}"
        title="${item#*:}"
        if [ "$title" = "$CHOSEN" ] || [ "$stem" = "$CHOSEN" ]; then
            selected_stem="$stem"
            break
        fi
    done

    [ -z "$selected_stem" ] && selected_stem=$(echo "$CHOSEN" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | tr ' ' '_')
    SELECTED_PATH="$WALL_DIR/${selected_stem}.jpg"

    if [ -f "$SELECTED_PATH" ]; then
        # Terapkan wallpaper ke Hyprland
        if command -v swww &>/dev/null; then
            swww img "$SELECTED_PATH" --transition-type wipe --transition-duration 1.5
        elif command -v hyprctl &>/dev/null && pgrep -x hyprpaper >/dev/null; then
            hyprctl hyprpaper preload "$SELECTED_PATH"
            hyprctl hyprpaper wallpaper ",$SELECTED_PATH"
            hyprctl hyprpaper unload all >/dev/null 2>&1
        elif command -v swaybg &>/dev/null; then
            pkill -x swaybg 2>/dev/null
            swaybg -i "$SELECTED_PATH" -m fill &
        fi
        notify-send "Renaissance OS" "Wallpaper applied: $CHOSEN" -i "$SELECTED_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
fi
```

## Assistant

Seluruh wallpaper telah diperiksa menggunakan tool visi visual, disesuaikan ke resolusi presisi **1920x1200** (16:10), dan karya seni yang sebelumnya terpotong secara canggung atau rusak telah diganti dengan mahakarya Renaissance berformat *landscape* sejati.

---

### 1. Evaluasi & Perbaikan Wallpaper (Hasil Inspeksi Visual)

| Kartu & Judul | Status Sebelum | Solusi & Hasil Baru (1920x1200) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **The Creation of Adam** *(Michelangelo)* | Kepala Adam terpotong di atas | **Diperbaiki:** Menggunakan teknik *feathered plaster fresco canvas extension*. Seluruh figur Adam, Tuhan, dan kedua jari yang saling menyentuh kini utuh 100%. |
| **Primavera** *(Sandro Botticelli)* | *(Sebelumnya Mona Lisa terpotong di mulut)* | **Diganti:** Digantikan oleh mahakarya *Primavera* (Botticelli) rasio *true landscape*. Semua figur nimfa, dewi, dan Cupid tampil utuh dari ujung kepala hingga kaki. |
| **The Tower of Babel** *(Pieter Bruegel)* | *(Sebelumnya Vitruvian Man terpotong di dagu & kaki)* | **Diganti:** Digantikan oleh lukisan *The Tower of Babel* (Bruegel). Puncak menara awan, para tukang batu, dan teluk kapal tampil megah tanpa terpotong. |
| **The Birth of Venus** *(Sandro Botticelli)* | Sudah landscape utuh | **Dipertahankan:** Komposisi Venus di atas kerang laut dan tiupan dewa angin Zephyr 100% utuh. |
| **The Annunciation** *(Leonardo da Vinci)* | *(Sebelumnya duplikat School of Athens)* | **Diganti:** Digantikan oleh mahakarya *Annunciation* (Leonardo da Vinci) resolusi tinggi. Malaikat Gabriel, Maria, taman, dan pemandangan pegunungan Italia tampil utuh dan bebas dari garis pigura kayu museum. |
| **The Last Supper** *(Leonardo da Vinci)* | Sudah landscape utuh | **Dipertahankan:** Yesus dan keduabelas murid pada perjamuan terakhir tampil simetris dan penuh. |
| **Classical Ruins** *(Claude Lorrain)* | Foto HP buram menampilkan dinding museum & pigura emas | **Diganti:** Digantikan oleh lukisan asli *Capriccio of the Roman Forum & Colosseum* (Claude Lorrain - Google Art Project). Reruntuhan pilar Korintus dan Colosseum tampil sangat tajam dan bersih. |
| **The School of Athens** *(Raphael)* | Sudah landscape utuh | **Dipertahankan:** Fresko Plato, Aristoteles, dan filsuf Yunani di lorong lengkung Renaisans tampil utuh dan presisi. |

---

### 2. Standardisasi Rofi Wallpaper Selector & Launcher

1. **Wallpaper Grid Rofi (`wallpaper_grid.rasi`)**:
   - **Grid Simetris 2×4:** 8 kartu berukuran seimbang dengan kartu berorientasi vertikal elegan.
   - **Tipografi:** Font distandardisasi menggunakan **Inter** (`Inter 11` & `Inter 12`) selaras dengan Waybar dan konsep *Digital Humanism*.
   - **Visual Clean & Elegan:** Menghilangkan outline 1px yang kaku pada kartu non-aktif; aksen emas (`#db9c5e`) hanya muncul secara halus pada kartu aktif/terpilih.
   - **Bahasa Inggris Standar:** Teks input diubah menjadi *"Search / Choose Renaissance Wallpaper"*.

2. **Skrip Selector (`wp_selector.sh`)**:
   - Menghubungkan seluruh 8 file wallpaper baru dan memperbarui thumbnail 340×260 otomatis di `.thumbs/`.
   - Mendukung penerapan wallpaper langsung melalui `swaybg`, `hyprpaper`, maupun `swww`.

Di atas sistem Arch Linux dan Hyprland, pengguna tidak lagi diposisikan sebagai konsumen pasif yang tunduk pada aturan algoritma korporat. Pengguna memegang kendali dan kedaulatan penuh (full sovereignty) untuk merancang, mengontrol, dan memodifikasi lingkungan komputasinya sesuai kebutuhan intelektualnya.3. /* ==============================================================================
   SCHOOL OF ATHENS : SWAYNC NOTIFICATION & CONTROL CENTER THEME
   Filosofi: Digital Humanism & Academic Classical Refinement (Everforest Warm)
   ============================================================================== */

* {
  font-family: "Inter", sans-serif;
  font-size: 13px;
}

window#swaync-notification-window,
window#swaync-control-center {
  background: transparent;
}

/* Floating Notification Container */
.floating-notifications {
  background: transparent;
}

.floating-notifications .notification-row {
  outline: none;
  background: transparent;
}

.floating-notifications .notification-background {
  padding: 2px 0px;
}

/* Floating Notification Card */
.notification {
  background-color: rgba(26, 31, 35, 0.96);
  border: 1.5px solid #db9c5e;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  margin: 3px 6px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
  color: #d3c6aa;
}

.notification:hover {
  background-color: rgba(33, 40, 45, 0.98);
}

.notification-default-action {
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 10px;
}

.notification-content {
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  spacing: 12px;
}

/* Notification Preview / Icon */
.notification-content .image {
  -gtk-icon-size: 48px;
  min-width: 48px;
  min-height: 48px;
  max-width: 64px;
  max-height: 48px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  margin: 0 10px 0 0;
}

.notification-content .app-icon {
  -gtk-icon-size: 16px;
  margin: 2px;
}

/* Text Container */
.notification-content .text-box {
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
}

.notification-content .summary {
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  color: #e5c07b;
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}

.notification-content .time {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #859289;
  font-weight: normal;
  margin-right: 20px;
}

.notification-content .body {
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.35;
  color: #d3c6aa;
}

/* Close Button */
.close-button {
  background: rgba(219, 156, 94, 0.15);
  color: #db9c5e;
  border: 1px solid rgba(219, 156, 94, 0.35);
  border-radius: 50%;
  min-width: 18px;
  min-height: 18px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 2px 2px 0 0;
}

.close-button:hover {
  background: rgba(219, 156, 94, 0.4);
  color: #fbf2db;
}

/* Control Center Panel */
.control-center {
  background-color: rgba(24, 28, 32, 0.96);
  border: 1.5px solid #db9c5e;
  border-radius: 16px;
  color: #d3c6aa;
  padding: 14px;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
}

.control-center .notification {
  background-color: rgba(35, 42, 48, 0.85);
  border: 1px solid rgba(219, 156, 94, 0.3);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  margin: 4px 2px;
}

.control-center .notification:hover {
  background-color: rgba(45, 54, 62, 0.95);
  border-color: #db9c5e;
}

/* Backlight Widget */
.widget-backlight {
  background-color: rgba(35, 42, 48, 0.85);
  padding: 12px 14px;
  margin: 6px 2px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(219, 156, 94, 0.25);
}

scale trough {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  border-radius: 8px;
  min-height: 10px;
}

scale highlight {
  background: #db9c5e;
  border-radius: 8px;
}

/* Widget Title & Clear Button */
.widget-title {
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #e5c07b;
}

.widget-title button {
  background: rgba(219, 156, 94, 0.2);
  border: 1px solid rgba(219, 156, 94, 0.35);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 4px 12px;
  color: #e5c07b;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.widget-title button:hover {
  background: rgba(219, 156, 94, 0.35);
  color: #fbf2db;
}

```
#!/usr/bin/env bash

# ==============================================================================
# SCHOOL OF ATHENS : THEME & KEYBIND TOGGLER
# Mengalihkan desktop host antara mode normal dan School of Athens (Waybar Masterpiece)
# Tanpa merusak file konfigurasi asli apapun!
# ==============================================================================

STATE_FILE="/tmp/renaissance_mode_active"
ASSETS_DIR="/home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets"
WAYBAR_CONF="$ASSETS_DIR/dotfiles/waybar/config.jsonc"
WAYBAR_STYLE="$ASSETS_DIR/dotfiles/waybar/style.css"
WALLPAPER="$ASSETS_DIR/wallpapers/school_of_athens.jpg"

enable_renaissance() {
    echo "🏛 Mengaktifkan Mode School of Athens..."

    # 1. Pasang Flag State Aktif
    touch "$STATE_FILE"

    # 2. Matikan instance Quickshell & Waybar lama
    killall -9 qs quickshell 2>/dev/null
    pkill -x waybar 2>/dev/null

    # 3. Pasang Wallpaper Klasik School of Athens via swaybg
    pkill -x swaybg 2>/dev/null
    swaybg -i "$WALLPAPER" -m fill &

    # 4. Pastikan Notification Daemon (swaync) aktif untuk notifikasi & screenshot
    if ! pgrep -x swaync >/dev/null; then
        nohup swaync >/dev/null 2>&1 &
    else
        swaync-client -R -rs 2>/dev/null || true
    fi

    # 5. Reload Hyprland untuk mengaktifkan keybinds & estetika School of Athens
    hyprctl reload 2>/dev/null

    # 6. Nyalakan Waybar School of Athens Masterpiece
    waybar -c "$WAYBAR_CONF" -s "$WAYBAR_STYLE" &

    # 7. Berikan notifikasi aktivasi
    notify-send "🏛 School of Athens" "Mode Digital Humanism Aktif!\n• Super+Space / Super+D : Application Launcher\n• Super+K / Ctrl+Super+T : Wallpaper Selector\n• Super+A : Control Center\n• Super+Shift+S / Super+Shift+Space : Tangkapan Layar Area\n• Super+Print : Menu Tangkapan Layar\nJalankan script lagi untuk kembali." -i "$WALLPAPER" 2>/dev/null || true
    echo "Mode School of Athens Aktif!"
}

disable_renaissance() {
    echo "🔄 Mengembalikan desktop ke profil semula..."

    # 1. Hapus Flag State
    rm -f "$STATE_FILE"

    # 2. Matikan Waybar, swaybg, dan swaync
    pkill -x waybar 2>/dev/null
    pkill -x swaybg 2>/dev/null
    pkill -x swaync 2>/dev/null

    # 3. Hidupkan kembali Quickshell bawaan host
    qs -c ii -d &

    # 4. Reload config Hyprland asli
    hyprctl reload

    notify-send "Desktop Normal" "Desktop & keybinds telah dikembalikan ke konfigurasi asli." 2>/dev/null || true
    echo "Desktop telah dikembalikan!"
}

# Toggle Logic
if [ -f "$STATE_FILE" ]; then
    disable_renaissance
else
    enable_renaissance
fi

```

```
#!/usr/bin/env bash

# ==============================================================================
# SCHOOL OF ATHENS : SCREENSHOT TOOL
# Filosofi: Digital Humanism & Distraction-Free Classical Aesthetic
# Fitur: Potong Area (Snip), Layar Penuh, Jendela Aktif, Swappy Edit, & Rofi Menu
# ==============================================================================

TARGET_DIR="${XDG_PICTURES_DIR:-$HOME/Pictures}/Screenshots"
mkdir -p "$TARGET_DIR"

TIMESTAMP=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d_%H.%M.%S')
FILENAME="Screenshot_${TIMESTAMP}.png"
FILEPATH="${TARGET_DIR}/${FILENAME}"

# Warna seleksi Slurp bernuansa Renaissance Gold (#db9c5e) dan Dark Slate (#1c2124)
SLURP_ARGS=(-b "1c212488" -c "db9c5eff" -s "282c3444" -w 2)

notify_success() {
    local file="$1"
    local title="$2"
    local desc="$3"
    if command -v notify-send >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        notify-send -a "School of Athens" \
            -i "$file" \
            "$title" \
            "$desc" \
            2>/dev/null || true
    fi
}

case "$1" in
    "snip"|"region"|"area")
        GEOM=$(slurp "${SLURP_ARGS[@]}")
        [ -z "$GEOM" ] && exit 0
        grim -g "$GEOM" "$FILEPATH"
        wl-copy --type image/png < "$FILEPATH"
        notify_success "$FILEPATH" "🏛 Tangkapan Layar Area" "Tersimpan: $FILENAME\nDisalin ke papan klip."
        ;;

    "full"|"fullscreen"|"screen")
        sleep 0.15
        grim "$FILEPATH"
        wl-copy --type image/png < "$FILEPATH"
        notify_success "$FILEPATH" "🏛 Tangkapan Layar Penuh" "Tersimpan: $FILENAME\nDisalin ke papan klip."
        ;;

    "window")
        ACTIVE_WINDOW=$(hyprctl activewindow -j 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -n "$ACTIVE_WINDOW" ] && [ "$ACTIVE_WINDOW" != "{}" ]; then
            GEOM=$(echo "$ACTIVE_WINDOW" | jq -r '"\(.at[0]),\(.at[1]) \(.size[0])x\(.size[1])"')
            grim -g "$GEOM" "$FILEPATH"
            wl-copy --type image/png < "$FILEPATH"
            notify_success "$FILEPATH" "🏛 Tangkapan Jendela Aktif" "Tersimpan: $FILENAME\nDisalin ke papan klip."
        else
            GEOM=$(slurp "${SLURP_ARGS[@]}")
            [ -z "$GEOM" ] && exit 0
            grim -g "$GEOM" "$FILEPATH"
            wl-copy --type image/png < "$FILEPATH"
            notify_success "$FILEPATH" "🏛 Tangkapan Layar Area" "Tersimpan: $FILENAME\nDisalin ke papan klip."
        fi
        ;;

    "edit"|"swappy")
        GEOM=$(slurp "${SLURP_ARGS[@]}")
        [ -z "$GEOM" ] && exit 0
        if command -v swappy >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            grim -g "$GEOM" - | swappy -f -
        else
            grim -g "$GEOM" "$FILEPATH"
            wl-copy --type image/png < "$FILEPATH"
            notify_success "$FILEPATH" "🏛 Tangkapan Layar Area" "Tersimpan: $FILENAME\nDisalin ke papan klip."
        fi
        ;;

    "delay")
        SEC="${2:-5}"
        if command -v notify-send >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            notify-send -a "School of Athens" "🏛 Tangkapan Layar Tunda" "Mengambil tangkapan layar dalam $SEC detik..." 2>/dev/null || true
        fi
        sleep "$SEC"
        grim "$FILEPATH"
        wl-copy --type image/png < "$FILEPATH"
        notify_success "$FILEPATH" "🏛 Tangkapan Layar Tunda" "Tersimpan: $FILENAME\nDisalin ke papan klip."
        ;;

    "menu"|*)
        SCRIPT_PATH="$(readlink -f "$0")"
        ROFI_THEME="/home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/dotfiles/rofi/screenshot_menu.rasi"
        
        OPTIONS="󰒆  Potong Area (Snip Selection)\n󰹑  Layar Penuh (Fullscreen)\n󱂬  Jendela Aktif (Active Window)\n󰏫  Potong & Anotasi (Swappy Editor)\n󱞩  Tunda 5 Detik (5s Delay Fullscreen)\n📁  Buka Folder Screenshots"
        
        CHOSEN=$(echo -e "$OPTIONS" | rofi -dmenu -theme "$ROFI_THEME" -p "📸" -no-custom)
        case "$CHOSEN" in
            *"Potong Area"*)
                exec "$SCRIPT_PATH" snip
                ;;
            *"Layar Penuh"*)
                exec "$SCRIPT_PATH" full
                ;;
            *"Jendela Aktif"*)
                exec "$SCRIPT_PATH" window
                ;;
            *"Potong & Anotasi"*)
                exec "$SCRIPT_PATH" edit
                ;;
            *"Tunda 5 Detik"*)
                exec "$SCRIPT_PATH" delay 5
                ;;
            *"Buka Folder"*)
                xdg-open "$TARGET_DIR" 2>/dev/null || nautilus "$TARGET_DIR" 2>/dev/null &
                ;;
        esac
        ;;
esac
```

```
#!/usr/bin/env bash

# ==============================================================================
# SCHOOL OF ATHENS : ROFI WALLPAPER SELECTOR
# Standardized Classical Art Selector (Faithful Mockup Layout)
# ==============================================================================

WALL_DIR="/home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/wallpapers"
THUMB_DIR="$WALL_DIR/.thumbs"
THEME_RASI="/home/rifqi/Workspace/Belajar/SO/Tubes-2604/Rancangan/assets/dotfiles/rofi/wallpaper_grid.rasi"

if [ ! -d "$WALL_DIR" ]; then
    notify-send "Wallpaper Error" "Wallpaper directory not found"
    exit 1
fi

mkdir -p "$THUMB_DIR"

# Definisi 8 karya seni klasik Renaissance persis urutan mockup
ITEMS=(
    "the_creation_of_adam:The Creation of Adam"
    "primavera:Primavera"
    "tower_of_babel:The Tower of Babel"
    "birth_of_venus:The Birth of Venus"
    "annunciation:The Annunciation"
    "the_last_supper:The Last Supper"
    "classical_ruins:Classical Ruins"
    "school_of_athens:The School of Athens"
)

ENTRY_LIST=""
for item in "${ITEMS[@]}"; do
    stem="${item%%:*}"
    title="${item#*:}"
    img="$WALL_DIR/${stem}.jpg"
    thumb="$THUMB_DIR/${stem}.jpg"

    [ -f "$img" ] || continue

    # Buat thumbnail jika belum ada
    if [ ! -f "$thumb" ]; then
        magick "$img" -resize 340x260^ -gravity center -extent 340x260 -quality 95 "$thumb" 2>/dev/null
    fi

    icon_to_use="$thumb"
    [ -f "$icon_to_use" ] || icon_to_use="$img"

    # Format Rofi dmenu: Title\0icon\x1fPath
    ENTRY_LIST+="$title\0icon\x1f$icon_to_use\n"
done

CHOSEN=$(echo -en "$ENTRY_LIST" | rofi -dmenu -theme "$THEME_RASI" -p "📁")

if [ -n "$CHOSEN" ]; then
    # Cari stem yang cocok dengan title
    selected_stem=""
    for item in "${ITEMS[@]}"; do
        stem="${item%%:*}"
        title="${item#*:}"
        if [ "$title" = "$CHOSEN" ] || [ "$stem" = "$CHOSEN" ]; then
            selected_stem="$stem"
            break
        fi
    done

    [ -z "$selected_stem" ] && selected_stem=$(echo "$CHOSEN" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | tr ' ' '_')
    SELECTED_PATH="$WALL_DIR/${selected_stem}.jpg"

    if [ -f "$SELECTED_PATH" ]; then
        # Terapkan wallpaper ke Hyprland
        if command -v swww &>/dev/null; then
            swww img "$SELECTED_PATH" --transition-type wipe --transition-duration 1.5
        elif command -v hyprctl &>/dev/null && pgrep -x hyprpaper >/dev/null; then
            hyprctl hyprpaper preload "$SELECTED_PATH"
            hyprctl hyprpaper wallpaper ",$SELECTED_PATH"
            hyprctl hyprpaper unload all >/dev/null 2>&1
        elif command -v swaybg &>/dev/null; then
            pkill -x swaybg 2>/dev/null
            swaybg -i "$SELECTED_PATH" -m fill &
        fi
        notify-send "School of Athens" "Wallpaper applied: $CHOSEN" -i "$SELECTED_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
fi
```

```
/**
 * =============================================================================
 * SCHOOL OF ATHENS : ROFI WALLPAPER SELECTOR GRID
 * Visual Grid Layout: 2 Rows x 4 Columns
 * Desain: Bersih, Humanis Modern (Font Inter), Tanpa Outline Nanggung
 * =============================================================================
 */

* {
    font: "Inter 11";
    bg-base: rgba(28, 33, 37, 0.95);
    bg-card: rgba(42, 50, 56, 0.85);
    bg-active: rgba(219, 156, 94, 0.22);
    border-gold: #db9c5e;
    fg-main: #d3c6aa;
    fg-bright: #fbf2db;
    fg-muted: #859289;

    background-color: transparent;
    text-color: @fg-main;
    margin: 0px;
    padding: 0px;
}

window {
    width: 980px;
    background-color: @bg-base;
    border: 1.5px;
    border-color: @border-gold;
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 24px;
    location: center;
    anchor: center;
}

mainbox {
    children: [ inputbar, listview ];
    spacing: 18px;
}

inputbar {
    background-color: rgba(18, 22, 25, 0.75);
    border: 0px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 12px 18px;
    children: [ prompt, entry ];
    spacing: 12px;
}

prompt {
    font: "Inter 13";
    text-color: @border-gold;
    vertical-align: 0.5;
}

entry {
    placeholder: "Search / Choose Wallpaper";
    placeholder-color: @fg-muted;
    text-color: @fg-bright;
    font: "Inter 12";
    vertical-align: 0.5;
}

listview {
    layout: vertical;
    lines: 2;
    columns: 4;
    cycle: true;
    dynamic: false;
    spacing: 16px;
    flow: horizontal;
    fixed-columns: true;
}

element {
    orientation: vertical;
    padding: 6px 6px 12px 6px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background-color: @bg-card;
    border: 0px;
    spacing: 8px;
    children: [ element-icon, element-text ];
}

element selected.normal {
    background-color: @bg-active;
    border: 2px;
    border-color: @border-gold;
}

element-icon {
    size: 195px;
    horizontal-align: 0.5;
    border-radius: 8px;
}

element-text {
    font: "Inter 11";
    horizontal-align: 0.5;
    text-color: #d3c6aa;
}

element selected.normal element-text {
    text-color: #fbf2db;
}
```
